Chapter 510 - 510 Treat; My Mom Is Here! (2)

510 Treat; My Mom Is Here! (2)

“Mr. Lin, you came at the right time today!”

As he spoke, he started to dance.

The men and women in suits and leather shoes smelled like smoke, and the corners of their mouths could not help but twitch.

Earlier, when they were saying these words, Zhang Zhou only nodded lightly and was extremely arrogant.

In the end, when he faced these two young people, he started to dance and talk.

Why did his attitude change so much?

Jiangbei Hotel was very efficient.

After a while, delicious dishes were served one after another.

Lin Fan picked up some food and put it into his mouth. He nodded slightly and said, “Cousin, try this. It’s not bad.”

Lin Zihao also picked up a piece with his chopsticks and praised sincerely, “It’s delicious!”

When Zhang Zhou heard this, he heaved a sigh of relief.

After all, he had just recommended the dishes here.

If they were not delicious, then it would be a little difficult.

Then, like a child hearing a teacher’s praise, Zhang Zhou’s entire face immediately curled up into a smile.

“Today, we’re honored to be able to have a meal with you two. I suggest… Let’s toast to the two Mr. Lins!”

After saying that, Zhang Zhou picked up his wine glass and stood up.

Everyone present also raised their glasses and stood up.

After that, everyone downed the wine in their glasses.

At this moment, there was a crisp knock on the door.

Then, a man in a white shirt walked in.

It was the general manager of Jiangbei Hotel, Zhang Shanfeng.

“I just heard from the people below that Mr. Lin is here for a meal, so I specially came to toast you. I hope I didn’t disturb you.”

As soon as he said this, many people’s hearts jumped wildly.

They knew Zhang Shanfeng and knew that he was the general manager of Jiangbei Hotel.

It was because of this that they were even more surprised.

If it were an ordinary restaurant, it would be fine.

However, Jiangbei Hotel had a very deep official background.

Even the general manager of Jiangbei Hotel rushed over to toast Lin Fan when he heard that Lin Fan was here.

Who exactly was this young man called Lin Fan?

Compared to the shock in everyone’s hearts, Lin Fan was still extremely calm.

“You’re not disturbing us. We’re just eating.”

“That’s good, that’s good…” Zhang Shanfeng heaved a sigh of relief.

“Mr. Lin, thank you for coming to our Jiangbei Hotel for your meal. Here’s a toast to you.”

After saying that, he picked up the wine glass and drank it in one gulp.

Then, Zhang Shanfeng poured himself another glass of wine and said, “Thank you for coming to the Jiangbei Hotel. I hope everyone will enjoy the meal.”

With that, he finished the wine in his glass.

Everyone present, including Zhang Zhou, the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City, quickly raised their glasses and said, “Manager Zhang, you’re too polite.”

As soon as they finished speaking, they also drank the contents of their glasses in one gulp.

“Then I won’t disturb you.”

This meal…

Everyone would occasionally find an opportunity to toast Lin Fan and Lin Zihao, wanting to get closer to them.

They understood that this would definitely be of great benefit to them.

Lin Fan did not reject any toasts.

After all, he had Drinking Gentleman, allowing him to drink a thousand glasses and not get drunk.

Lin Zihao’s alcohol tolerance was much lower.

Fortunately, everyone did not dare to say much about it. They drank it all themselves, but Lin Zihao only took a small sip.

Everyone had a great time during the meal.

When Lin Fan returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa, the sky had already turned completely dark.

After taking a shower, he lay down on the LV custom-made bed and fell asleep comfortably.

…

The night passed in the blink of an eye.

The two little birds on the branches gently stamped their feet and made a crisp sound.

“How many bugs did you catch today?”

“One.”

“Hehe, I got two!”

“Hmph, we also got two!”

…

In the past, Lin Fan could hear the conversation of the birds outside the window.

And after taking the Hearing Enhancement Potion, these sounds became even clearer.

Out of habit, he glanced at his phone. As usual, a text message appeared on the screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 36,790,201 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, he turned his attention to the sign-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received ten million yuan.]

Lin Fan yawned and lay on the bed for a while before slowly getting up.

After eating M9 beef rolls, king crab bread, and a glass of premium milk, he drove the Cullinan to Jiangbei University as usual.

…

To Lin Fan, today was a very ordinary day.

However, to Lin Zihao, it was exceptionally unusual.

While Lin Zihao was still asleep, a sudden ringtone woke him up.

He looked at the caller ID and realized that it was his girlfriend, Zhong Jieyu.

“Good morning, Jieyu,” Lin Zihao said.

Zhong Jieyu said anxiously. “Zihao, my mother is in Jiangbei! I told her that you’re a senior executive of the company, a director! However, she insists on going to your company to take a look. What should we do now?”

His eyes, which were initially still a little sleepy, immediately widened as he sat up on the bed.

“You… Your mother is going to my company? Moreover, you even said that I’m the company’s director?” Lin Zihao said in surprise.

“Yeah, you know that my mother is a little powerful. If I didn’t say that, she wouldn’t have agreed to us being in a relationship at all… Quickly think about what to do now!” Zhong Jieyu said, “Why don’t you find a few good colleagues to help you put on an act?”

Lin Zihao thought for a moment and said, “That should be the only way for now.”

After hanging up the phone, Lin Zihao hurriedly washed up and changed into his best suit.

He hailed a taxi and rushed toward the company.

He finally arrived at the company before Zhong Jieyu and her mother.

The company’s executives rarely came to the company in the morning.

Today was the same.

Lin Zihao heaved a sigh of relief. After promising to treat them to a meal, he finally convinced his colleagues to help him act.

Following the sound of the elevator, a young woman with a good figure, a middle-aged woman wearing a pearl necklace, and a man in a checkered shirt slowly walked in.

They… They were Zhong Jieyu, Zheng Jing, and Liu Wei.

When Lin Zihao saw Zhong Jieyu from afar, he strode forward and smiled. “Jieyu, you’re here?”

Zhong Jieyu nodded uneasily. When she noticed Lin Zihao’s reassuring gaze, she breathed a sigh of relief.

She pointed at Zheng Jing and said, “This is my mother.”

“This is Liu Wei, the son of my mother’s friend.”

“Hello, Aunt.”

Zheng Jing nodded her head lightly without much expression.

Lin Zihao could not help but feel a little embarrassed. He took the initiative to reach out to Liu Wei and said, “Hello, Liu Wei. I’m Jieyu’s boyfriend.”

Liu Wei and Lin Zihao shook hands lightly and said their greetings.

“I heard from Jieyu that you’re the director of Xuanyuan Trading Comapny,” Zheng Jing said. “It shouldn’t be a problem for you to bring us in to take a look, right?”

“Of course, there’s no problem. Please come in.”

As soon as he entered the company, a man wearing black-rimmed glasses walked over quickly with a stack of documents.

“Director Lin, so you’re here?” he hurriedly said to Lin Zihao. “Our company has signed a 20 million yuan contract with Xiao Wu Wholesale City. These documents require your approval. Are you free now?”

His attitude was very respectful, and there was a hint of pleading in his tone.

If Lin Zihao did not know that he was just a small-time employee, he was afraid that he would really think that he was the director.

It had to be said that the black-framed glasses man’s acting skills were not bad.

He cleared his throat and said, “Okay, put them aside for now. I’ll come over to approve them later.”

Liu Wei, who was standing at the side, curled his lips slightly and revealed an imperceptible sneer. He said, “A 20 million yuan contract? Can you show us?”
